sents.t: How do you shortcut that desire contract?
sents.zh: 怎样才能绕过这种“欲望契约”——也就是“得不到就不允许自己快乐”的约定？

sents.t: You could focus, you could decide that I don’t want most things.
sents.zh: 你可以专注，你可以决定：大多数东西我都不想要。

sents.t: I think we have a lot of unnecessary desires that we just pick up everywhere, have opinions on everything, judgments on everything,
sents.zh: 我觉得，我们有很多其实没必要的欲望，是在生活中不知不觉沾染来的；我们对什么都想发表意见，对什么都想评头论足。

sents.t: so I think just knowing that those are the source of unhappiness will make you be choosy about your desires.
sents.zh: 只要意识到这些欲望正是不幸福的来源，你就会更谨慎地选择自己究竟要追求什么。

sents.t: And frankly if you want to be successful, you have to be choosy about your desires, you have to focus.
sents.zh: 而且说真的，如果你想有所成就，就必须有所取舍，认真选择自己的欲望，把精力集中在重要的事情上。

sents.t: You can’t be great at everything. You’re just going to waste your energy and waste your time.
sents.zh: 你不可能样样都做得很好。那样你只会浪费精力，浪费时间。
